headings.usage: Brand moments, Login screen hero text, or massive report totals to keep a subtle nod to the old warm build while transitioning to the professional ERP.

body.usage: General UI, forms, sidebar navigation, standard buttons. Ensures maximum readability.

numbers.usage: Currency (IDR), table data, phone numbers, stock quantities, and PPOB references. Tabular lining.

primary.description: Professional Blue - Trustworthy, clean, clinical for ERP

warning.usage: Status 'Antre', Stok Low. Keeps the gold warm touch (#caaa72 vibe)

danger.usage: Status 'Diambil' (or closed out), Pengeluaran, Hutang. Nod to old red (#d34545)

surfaces.topbar: bg-white border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-50

global_layout.structure: Persistent left sidebar (w-64) + Top bar (h-16) + Main content area.
global_layout.spacing: p-6 md:p-8 for main content blocks.

dashboard_kpi.grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6
dashboard_kpi.card_style: bg-white p-5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between

pos_kasir.layout: 2-column layout: Left (70%) for Product Grid/Search/Trade-in calculator, Right (30%) for Cart Summary & Checkout.
pos_kasir.trade_in: Dedicated section in POS to input Grade A/B/C/D and calculate final price dynamically.

data_tables.style: Dense tabular layout. text-sm, compact padding (py-2 px-3). Sticky header.
data_tables.actions: Action menus (Shadcn Dropdown) on the far right column.

motion.hover: Transition on buttons and table rows (bg-slate-50). duration-200 ease-in-out.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Avoid transparent overlays on forms.
accessibility.focus: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-sky-500 focus:ring-offset-2 on all inputs and buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='kpi-penjualan-card', data-testid='pos-checkout-btn').

login_background.description: Modern abstract blue wavy lines for login page background

buttons.primary: bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

status_badges.antre: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
status_badges.diproses: bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
status_badges.selesai: bg-green-100 text-green-800 border border-green-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium
status_badges.diambil: bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 border border-slate-200 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

inputs.style: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-sky-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-sky-500

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Geist Mono for all tabular numbers, currency, and IDs. Install Instrument Serif for brand headers.
Use Phosphor Icons (or Lucide) for sidebar navigation.
Build the dashboard using standard Shadcn components heavily styled to match the clean, tight-density look.
Never use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals.
Implement the POS (Kasir) view as a highly functional, low-padding dense interface since speed is critical for retail.
Implement Trade-In (Tukar Tambah) modal with clear Grade A/B/C/D calculator options.
Service jobs pipeline must use the specific status badge colors.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e. do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap, EXCEPT in the data-dense POS/Tables where utility overrules breathing room.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner components are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js
Ensure the sidebar uses a dark theme (bg-slate-900) while the main dashboard uses a light theme (bg-slate-50) for maximum contrast and focus.
